section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants in a single study (Study X) using the Youth Body Image Survey (YBIS) conducted between September and December 2012. The initial sample of 14,056 participants was reduced to a final sample of 10,667 (8,925 US residents and 742 non-US residents from Canada, UK, and Australia) after excluding participants under 18 years old and those with incomplete data. BMI values ranged from 10.13 to 44.98 kg/m², and detailed demographic characteristics are referenced in Table 1 (not provided).
